{{See also|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Allwinner]] T527 [[ARM]] ([[big.LITTLE]]) :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A55) @1.8GHz + :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A55) @1.4GHz + :XuanTie E906 RISC-V core @ 200MHz :• NPU: 2 TOPS @INT8 :• Audio DSP: HIFI4 @ 600MHz :• GPU: ''Mali-G57 MC1'' (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0); :• VPU (with 4K @60fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 16MB (SP) Flash, eMMC socket, :TF card (max.64GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4GB (SDRAM) LPDDR4 *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43456 ([[AMPAK AP6256]]) :802.11abgn/ac (1T1R) + BT 5.0 Combo SiP Module *Network: 1x GbE port *USB: 4x USB 2.0 ports, :4-pin header (unpopulated) with USB 2.0 *PCI: 1x PCIe 2.0 M.2 (M-Key) slot *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power: 5V/5A via USB (Type-C)
